content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/or equivalent) + two years' experience in the relevant subject/field; OR three-year graduate degree in the relevant subject/field + one year's experience in the relevant subject. Experience required: Two years in the relevant subject/field (with 10th + Diploma); OR one year in the relevant subject (with graduate degree). Age limit: Maximum 28 years. Pay: ₹18,000 p.m. + HRA as admissible. Qualification required: 12th in science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/or equivalent) + five years' experience in the relevant subject/field; OR three-year graduate degree in the relevant subject/field + two years' experience in the relevant subject. Experience required: Five years in the relevant subject/field (with 12th + Diploma); OR two years in the relevant subject (with graduate degree). Age limit: Maximum 30 years. Pay: ₹20,000 p.m. + HRA as admissible.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary contractual basis, co-terminus with the project First contract up to one year; may be extended subject to requirement, performance review and ICMR extension of the project Project tenure two years (first year sanctioned 15.09.2026 to 14.09.2027), or co-terminus with the project Paid leave 1.5 days for each completed month of engagement Selected candidate must join within 30 days of the offer No claim to regularisation or permanent employment

content_sections.heading: How Will AIIMS Bibinagar Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Screening of applications by a screening committee against minimum essential qualification, age and experience, and shortlisting Written test, which may include a practical skill test, if there are more than 30 eligible candidates for a post Interview by a selection committee Merit list and waiting list for each post Screening committee scrutinises applications and shortlists candidates List of candidates eligible for interview will be displayed on the Institute website; shortlisted candidates are called by email Written test (may include a practical skill test in cytology and histology laboratory work) followed by interview if more than 30 eligible candidates for a post Merit list and waiting list for each post, valid for twelve months

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Proof of date of birth (10th certificate or birth certificate) Certificates and mark sheets of every qualification claimed, from a recognised Board or University Experience certificates stating the employer, the period and the nature of work An identity proof A recent photograph

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Bibinagar Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Fill the application form in the prescribed format (Annexure 1). Send the scanned soft copy with a recent photograph to [email protected] . Attach self-attested copies of the listed documents. Write 'Application for Project Technical Support-I/II under ICMR' in the subject line. Send a separate application for each post. Give contact details (address, mobile number, e-mail ID) in the form. Email it on or before 11 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications that are incomplete, not clear, illegible, not readable, late or without required documents will be rejected No TA or DA is payable for attending the interview Corrigendum or addendum will be published on the institute website only

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Bibinagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Bibinagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 2 Project Technical Support-I, 2 Project Technical Support-II.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AIIMS Bibinagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 11 December 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Project Technical Support-I: maximum 28 years; Project Technical Support-II: maximum 30 years. Relaxation: Government research organisation experience Up to 5 years, case-to-case, by competent authority, as permitted by ICMR.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹18,000 p.m. + HRA as admissible for Project Technical Support-I, ₹20,000 p.m. + HRA as admissible for Project Technical Support-II.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: PTS-I: 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/or equivalent) + two years' experience, OR three-year graduate degree in the relevant subject/field + one year's experience. PTS-II: 12th in science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/or equivalent) + five years' experience, OR three-year graduate degree in the relevant subject/field + two years' experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.answer: Yes. Experience is counted from the date of completing the minimum essential qualification. A candidate in Government, PSU or autonomous-body service must produce a no-objection certificate at the interview.

faq.answer: Persons already in regular time-scale service under any government organisation/department.
